initial_gap: The pinned SDK parsed stdio JSON-RPC before local handlers. It accepted duplicate keys, nonfinite and underflowing numbers, boolean-to-integer and JSON-string-to-object coercions, request envelopes carrying response fields, and invalid UTF-8 replaced with U+FFFD. Some malformed frames could mutate the case.

local_contract.sdk: mcp==2.2.0 pinned because the wrapper uses internal stdin fd claim and low-level server interfaces
local_contract.pre_sdk_validation: bounded binary line read, strict UTF-8, strict JSON without duplicate/nonfinite/underflow/decimal-loss values, request/response envelope and raw tool argument shape checks
local_contract.integer_fields: expected_version, expected_deps values, challenge_seq use strict integer validation
local_contract.on_reject: JSON-RPC error before tool dispatch; oversized line drained in bounded chunks; later valid frame continues

negative_controls: nested and escaped duplicate keys, duplicate root id
boolean expected_version, expected_deps value and challenge_seq
JSON-string data, refs, expected_deps, manifest and roles that the SDK could preparse
tools/call request mixed with result or error and extra envelope field
batch, boolean or null request id, invalid params shape
invalid UTF-8 byte in a would-be mutating tool call
oversized raw line drained before a valid next message
wire_observation: Each malformed mutating frame returned a parse, invalid-request or invalid-params error, left ledger bytes unchanged and allowed a subsequent valid status; a valid guarded put with object/list arguments still wrote exactly one expected event.

gates.command: ruff check scripts tests src; ruff format --check scripts/verify_secondary_sources.py tests/test_verify_secondary_sources.py src/specorganon/server.py tests/test_mcp_strict_json_boundary.py; git diff --check
uv build --wheel --offline; clean wheel installs with uv pip check and scripts/clean_smoke.py
gates.result: passed in isolated Python 3.11.15 and 3.12.3 environments; 14 CLI commands and 14 MCP tools, nine phases, 29 items, 49 events in each smoke

findings_closed: JSON strings were still converted by SDK pre_parse_json after initial raw JSON check
request with method and result was accepted and wrote a case event
invalid UTF-8 was replaced and could write changed text
unbounded line read could exhaust memory
private SDK interface was not covered by the original broad 2.x dependency constraint
independent_review.final_verdict: Independent wire probes rejected all identified malformed frames without ledger mutation; a valid follow-up and client smoke passed. No remaining bypass found in the bounded scope.

limits: The filter depends on private interfaces of pinned MCP 2.2.0 and its tested dependency resolution; other SDK versions need a new compatibility review.
The wrapper checks input syntax and shape, not client identity, source truth, human authority or all possible application semantics.
The full GOAL acceptance criteria still need independently custodied transitions, real intervention evidence and confirmatory model runs.
